turn.question: What if we cap any vendor at 40%?
turn.answer:
Applying a 40% cap per vendor among the eligible vendors (Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders) is **not feasible**.

The system could not find a distribution that respects the 40% constraint given only two eligible vendors. The resulting allocation resulted in shares of 54.2% and 45.8% respectively.

Furthermore, this scenario relies on **20 unconfirmed price points** (all flagged as medium confidence) from Ganesh Kraft Traders. You should not proceed with these values without confirmation.
